title: 第13章 小姨子 我不吃屎丹药第14章 小姨子吐了父亲怀疑有了
slug: 开局被退婚反手娶小姨子
lines: 商红雪脑袋晕晕的，整个人都处于大脑放空的状态，她不知道龙暝什么时候离开的，也不知道自己说了什么，问一句，回答一句，然后，没了。
然后，没有然后了。
傻乎乎的她，不小心碰到了姐姐商红尘，商红尘看着神态奇怪的妹妹，赶紧拉着妹妹。
“红雪，你怎么了？”
商红雪眨眼：“我没事，姐姐。”
商红尘一眼看出了她有问题，赶紧问：“红雪，有事情和姐姐说，姐姐会帮你解决的。”
商红雪张开口，总不能说人家龙暝阿姨看上她了，想让她当儿媳妇，要是告诉姐姐的话，姐姐肯定去闹腾，到最后，肯定会坏事的。
这件事情，她们知道就行了，这是秘密。
姐姐肯定不会同意的，她可看不上初阳哥哥。
只是……商红雪的脑袋晕晕的，一直都在重复着那句话，那就是龙暝最后所说的那句话“你愿意成为我儿子的媳妇儿吗？”
，对她的冲击太大了，哪怕过去了半个小时，她也没能回过神，实在是太直接了，太震撼了，太难为情了。
她没有回答，现场愣住了，好久都没回过神。
“没事，姐姐。”
“真的没事？你的样子不像是没事的样子，红雪，是不是陈初阳那个臭小子欺负你？你告诉姐姐，姐姐帮你揍他。”
“不是，姐姐，不关初阳哥哥的事情。”
商红雪立刻拉住了姐姐，姐姐一看到初阳哥哥肯定会打起来，她呢，可不想他们打起来。
一个是初阳哥哥，那可是她最……亲近的人。
另一个是姐姐，血脉至亲，谁都不能出事。
“红雪，记住了，姐姐永远站在你这边，你要是被欺负了，记得告诉姐姐，姐姐不会让你受委屈的。”
“我知道了。”
商红尘还是不放心自己的妹妹，她看了好几次，再三询问，都被商红雪说没事给拒绝了。
最后，她才依依不舍离开。
商红雪捏了一把汗。
“呼呼，吓死我了，姐姐要是去找初阳哥哥麻烦，我岂不是又要坏事？”
“初阳哥哥，我……”
商红雪回头，看到姐姐正在盯着她，这是在监视她，不让她离开商家。
商红雪无语，看来，她今天是无法离开商家的。
只能后面找机会。
三天时间，眨眼过去。
商红雪终于在这一天，找到了离开的机会。
姐姐闭关修炼去了，父亲和母亲也没空搭理她，她的好弟弟更加没心情搭理她。
商红雪盯了很久，偷偷摸摸离开商家，奔着龙蛇山而去。
一个时辰后。
龙蛇山脚下。
阵法阻挡下的龙蛇山，都是迷雾。
那一层迷雾看着十分震撼，第二次看到，商红雪依旧被震撼了，抬头看了许久，眼里都是龙蛇山的壮观模样，她往身后偷看，没有人跟来。
悄悄进入了龙蛇山，这一次她的进入可就没有遭遇危险，身上一块阵牌闪烁，那是陈初阳给她的阵牌，她是第一个陈家之外的人拿到了阵牌，陈初阳也害怕她遭遇危险，万一自己不在，这个丫头来找自己岂不是？
再三权衡之下，给她一块阵牌，就是为了预防万一。
“龙蛇山似乎又有了新的变化。”
商红雪进入了龙蛇山，察觉到了不一样的地方，细微的变化，瞒不过她。
抬头，看了看天空的迷雾。
流水迷雾阵当中，似乎多了其他的影子。
商红雪埋头爬山，半个时辰后，她成功来到了陈初阳居住的地方，还没打开门，一股炽热扑面而来，商红雪自觉停住了脚步，往后退了十米。
content_en:
Shang Hongxue's head was dizzy, and her whole body was in a state of mental emptiness. She didn't know when Long Ming left, or what she said. She asked and answered, and then it was gone.
Then, there was no more.
Silly, she accidentally bumped into her sister Shang Hongchen. Shang Hongchen looked at his sister who was acting strangely and quickly pulled her.
"Hongxue, what's wrong with you?"
Shang Hongxue blinked: "I'm fine, sister."
Shang Hongchen saw at a glance that she had a problem and quickly asked: "Hongxue, if you have something to tell me, sister will help you solve it."
Shang Hongxue opened her mouth. She couldn't say that Aunt Long Ming was interested in her and wanted her to be her daughter-in-law. If she told her sister, she would definitely make trouble and in the end, something bad would happen.
As long as they know about this, it's a secret.
My sister will definitely not agree. She looks down on Brother Chuyang.
It's just... Shang Hongxue's head was dizzy, and she kept repeating those words, which were the last words Long Ming said, "Are you willing to be my son's wife?"
, the impact on her was too great, even if half an hour passed, she could not come back to her senses. It was too direct, too shocking, and too embarrassing.
She didn't answer. She was stunned and didn't recover for a long time.
"It's okay, sister."
"Is it really okay? You don't look like you're okay, Hongxue, is that brat Chen Chuyang bullying you? Tell your sister and she will help you beat him up."
"No, sister, it's none of Brother Chuyang's business."
Shang Hongxue immediately grabbed her sister, who would definitely start a fight when she saw Brother Chuyang, but she didn't want them to fight.
One is Brother Chuyang, who is the person closest to her.
The other is my sister, a close relative by blood, nothing can happen to anyone.
"Hongxue, remember, sister will always be on your side. If you are bullied, remember to tell sister, she will not let you be wronged."
"I understand."
Shang Hongchen was still worried about her sister. She looked at her several times and asked again and again, but Shang Hongxue said she was fine and refused.
Finally, she reluctantly left.
Shang Hongxue sweated.
"Huhu, I'm scared to death. If my sister goes to trouble Brother Chuyang, won't I do bad things again?"
"Brother Chuyang, I..."
Shang Hongxue turned around and saw her sister staring at her. She was monitoring her and not letting her leave the business.
Shang Hongxue was speechless. It seemed that she would not be able to leave the business today.
We can only look for opportunities later.
Three days passed in the blink of an eye.
Shang Hongxue finally found the opportunity to leave on this day.
Her sister went into seclusion to practice, and her father and mother had no time to talk to her. Her good brother was even less in the mood to talk to her.
Shang Hongxue stared at it for a long time, then secretly left the business and headed towards Long Snake Mountain.
An hour later.
At the foot of Dragon Snake Mountain.
The Dragon Snake Mountain blocked by the formation was covered with fog.
That layer of fog looked very shocking. The second time she saw it, Shang Hongxue was still shocked. She looked up for a long time and saw the spectacular appearance of Longshen Mountain. She peeked behind her, but no one was following.
She quietly entered Dragon Snake Mountain. This time she entered without any danger. A formation card flashed on her body. It was the formation card given to her by Chen Chuyang. She was the first person outside the Chen family to get the formation card. Chen Chuyang was also afraid that she would be in danger. If he was not there, wouldn't this girl come to find him?
After weighing it again and again, I gave her a formation card just to be on the safe side.
"Dragon Snake Mountain seems to have undergone new changes."
Shang Hongxue entered Longshen Mountain and noticed something different. The subtle changes could not be hidden from her.
He raised his head and looked at the fog in the sky.
There seemed to be other shadows in the flowing mist formation.
Shang Hongxue immersed herself in climbing the mountain. Half an hour later, she successfully arrived at the place where Chen Chuyang lived. Before she opened the door, a blazing heat hit her face. Shang Hongxue consciously stopped and stepped back ten meters.
